content.core_identity: Context Layer for AI Agents / Multi-model Database

key_features.name: DiskANN Vector Indexing
key_features.impact: Eliminates need for standalone Vector DBs (e.g., Pinecone). Embeddings, graph relations, and JSON documents are queried in the same transaction boundary.

key_features.name: Surrealism Extensions (WASM)
key_features.impact: Business logic and AI transformations (Rust/Python compiled to WebAssembly) execute natively inside the database. Code moves to data, not data to code.

key_features.name: In-Memory Engine (Lock-free MVCC)
key_features.impact: Ultra-low latency for high-frequency operations, critical for Futarchy markets (Percolator). Supports direct query streaming for reactive UIs.

key_features.name: Native File Storage (Buckets)
key_features.impact: File pointers and blobs are stored directly within the database scope, reducing reliance on external S3/Cloud Storage for agent artifacts.

content.architectural_decision: SurrealDB replaces the fragmented stack (Relational + Graph + Vector + S3) to act as the single 'Hard Drive' and semantic memory for the CYNIC organism.
